testName: Engagement Studio Automated Drip Journey Trigger & Action Tracking
steps:
1. Open Account Engagement > Engagement Studio
2. Open active program "New Lead Onboarding Drip"
3. Add test prospect to recipient list "Onboarding Prospects"
4. Verify Step 1 triggers and sends "Welcome Email"
5. Simulate Email Open event on test email client
6. Verify Engagement Studio decision node "Email Opened?" evaluates to YES within wait window
7. Verify Step 2 branch executes: Send "Deep Dive Case Study"
8. Verify CRM Task "Follow up with engaged prospect" is automatically assigned to Sales Owner
